mechanism: Both drugs undergo renal elimination and may compete for renal clearance, particularly in patients with renal impairment; pregabalin is renally excreted unchanged while piperacillin tazobactam is also primarily renally cleared.
action: Monitor renal function and adjust pregabalin dosing based on creatinine clearance; ensure adequate hydration and consider dose adjustments if concurrent use in patients with renal compromise.
